purpose: Consolidated zero-cost policy document for the V2 production rollout: wave-gate strategy, QA taxonomy, stop/hold rules, failure/quarantine workflow, cost guardrails, prompt-hash integrity, and the raw-art/frame composition pipeline plan. No image generation. Companion to production_candidate_freeze_v1.json, canary_24_manifest_v1.json, qa_sampling_manifests_v1.json, rolling_sentinels_v1.json, cost_model_v1.json, and dry_run_report_v1.json in this same directory.

wave_gate_strategy.principle: No wave may auto-trigger the next wave. Every wave (Canary-24, Wave-B-48, Wave-C-96, each steady-state 120-batch) requires a separate, explicit, future user authorization after ChatGPT visual QA of that wave's sample - exactly the pattern already used and proven for every prior paid batch in this project (Validation-16, Validation-8, Recheck-3, the single-sentinel startups fix), none of which ever auto-triggered a follow-on batch.

waves.name: steady_state_batches
waves.note: Exact batch count and final remainder are computed dynamically from the actual remaining queue after reuse/canary/wave-B/wave-C are removed - see cost_model_v1.json for the real numbers this checkpoint (17 batches: 16x120 + 1x119), never hard-coded.

wave_gate_strategy.no_auto_chain_verification: Every runner script in this project (runObjectFirstV2Validation16.js, runObjectFirstV2Validation8HardSentinels.js, runObjectFirstV2Recheck3Final.js, runObjectFirstV2StartupsFinalRecheck.js) requires an explicit --submit invocation and contains no code path that invokes another runner or another wave. The same pattern must be followed by any future production-wave runner built from this queue.

qa_taxonomy.note: Kept intentionally compact per explicit instruction not to create an enormous scoring bureaucracy. Applied ONLY by ChatGPT/the user - Claude never assigns these labels to a generated image.

stop_hold_rules.principle: Distinguish an isolated card failure (quarantine that one card, keep the wave moving) from a systemic rule failure (HOLD the next wave entirely). Do not stop for one harmless MINOR. Final rollout gate decision always belongs to the user/ChatGPT - these are guidance thresholds, not an automatic kill switch.

hold_conditions.trigger: The same structural_containment_rule_id or archetype produces real-human leakage (body part, silhouette, reflection) on 2+ cards within one wave's QA sample.

The same structural_containment_rule_id produces the same wrong-neighboring-concept confusion on 2+ cards within one wave's QA sample (mirrors the business.startups electronics-hobby collapse pattern).
The same physical_logic_domain produces invisible-human-physics (an object operating/held with no support) on 2+ cards within one wave's QA sample.
The same text_mode family produces systemic pseudo-text or readable fake branding/product copy on 2+ cards within one wave's QA sample.
A recognizable real logo, trademark-like design, or copyrighted character appears on ANY card - single-occurrence HOLD, since brand/IP leakage is a legal/compliance risk, not merely an aesthetic one.

Clear rendered scene convergence (the same visual pattern - e.g. the Validation-16 dark-interior-plus-warm-lamp pattern - recurring) despite distinct scene_family metadata, observed across 3+ cards in one wave's QA sample.
2+ IMAGE_SAFETY or other content-policy blocks from the same structural_containment_rule_id or archetype within one wave.

isolated_card_response: mark QA failure with the specific flag(s)
quarantine that one canonical_id (queue generation_status -> qa_hold, quarantine_status -> quarantined)
do NOT reroll until the user explicitly authorizes a fix
systemic_rule_response: HOLD the next wave entirely - do not submit further cards using the implicated rule/domain/archetype

the implicated structural_containment_rule_id, physical_logic_domain, or text_mode must be reviewed and revised (creating a new prompt_sha256/production-candidate version, per the immutability rule) before any further generation using it
already-generated cards from the implicated rule in the CURRENT wave should be individually reviewed, not blanket-discarded

visual_fail_workflow: preserve the original failed image file, never delete or overwrite it
record the QA finding (verdict + flags) against that canonical_id in the queue
classify the failure as isolated (recipe-specific) or systemic (archetype/rule-wide) per stop_hold_rules above
set queue generation_status to qa_hold and quarantine_status to quarantined for that id
do NOT silently mutate the prompt - any fix requires a new prompt_sha256 and becomes a new production-candidate version
do NOT reroll until the user explicitly authorizes a fix

preserve full provenance: original image, original prompt, original prompt_sha256, and (once fixed) the new prompt/hash, exactly mirroring the repair_history pattern already used for the V1 Batch-1 repair
content_block_workflow: record the exact finish_reason (e.g. IMAGE_SAFETY) against that canonical_id
no automatic prompt mutation, no automatic retry
set generation_status to content_blocked and quarantine_status to quarantined
investigate only after that wave's QA is otherwise complete, not mid-wave
technical_failure_workflow: retry ONLY if the failed request is confirmed unbilled (the pattern already used in every runner in this project)
a technical retry is never counted as a visual reroll and never requires user re-authorization, since no content judgment was involved

cost_guardrails.hard_rule: No single authorized wave may exceed its approved budget. No automatic generation outside an explicitly approved wave. See cost_model_v1.json for the exact reconciled counts/costs for this checkpoint's queue (reuse=1, canary=24, wave_b=48, wave_c=96, steady_state=2039 across 17 batches, total_new_generation=2207, full_fresh_ceiling=$37.0944, revised_projected_cost=$37.0776, savings=$0.0168).
cost_guardrails.note_on_reuse_savings: The reuse savings this checkpoint are modest ($0.0168, 1 image) because 2 otherwise-accepted images (media.anime, learning.mock_trial) diverged from the canonical prompt due to a one-off local diversity patch made during the Recheck-3 test batch (see production_candidate_freeze_v1.json's rows and existing_art_inventory_v1.json for the full explanation) - those 2 ids are included in Canary-24 as fresh reconfirmation slots rather than being silently counted as reusable.

prompt_hash_version_integrity.rule: Before every generation request: verify canonical_id, production_candidate_version, exact prompt_sha256 (recompute live and compare against the frozen queue value), model, and queue state. If the live-recomputed SHA256 differs from the frozen queue value, ABORT that specific row - do not silently regenerate with a changed prompt. This exact pattern is already implemented and proven in every prior runner (runObjectFirstV2Validation16.js's/Validation8HardSentinels.js's/Recheck3Final.js's/StartupsFinalRecheck.js's loadFrozenRows() functions, which throw on mismatch).
prompt_hash_version_integrity.architecture_change_rule: If architecture changes after production starts (a new semantic fix, a new containment rule, a new global policy addition), that must create a NEW production-candidate version (e.g. v2.4) with its own frozen snapshot and new prompt hashes for every affected row - never a silent mutation of the v2.3 snapshot this checkpoint freezes. A migration/requeue decision (which in-flight or already-generated rows need to be regenerated under the new version) must be made explicitly, and historical provenance (which version actually generated which existing image) must never be overwritten.

frame_and_final_card_pipeline_plan.principle: Card frame composition is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for image generation. Never bake a card frame into a Gemini prompt or generation request.
pipeline_stages: raw generated artwork (from a production wave, per this queue)
technical validation (dimensions/format/hash - the same checks already used in every prior runner's technical_validation_v1.json)
visual QA (ChatGPT/user, per the qa_taxonomy above)
approved raw-art master (immutable once approved, provenance-tagged)
crop/fit artwork window to the card's artwork frame
app derivative sizes (thumbnails, list views, etc.)
frame_and_final_card_pipeline_plan.non_destructive_note: Regenerating art must never be forced merely because frame composition changes later - the raw art and the frame overlay are independently versioned and stored (see art_asset_directory_convention below).

art_asset_directory_convention.qa_metadata: tools/card_art/output/<experiment_or_wave_dir>/ (manifest.json, technical_validation_v1.json - existing convention; a future qa_results_v1.json per wave would sit alongside)
art_asset_directory_convention.approved_raw_art: PROPOSED, not yet created this checkpoint: tools/card_art/output/production_approved_v2/<canonical_id>/ - populated only after explicit ChatGPT/user visual approval, never auto-populated
art_asset_directory_convention.quarantined_art: PROPOSED: tools/card_art/output/production_quarantined_v2/<canonical_id>/ - failed/blocked cards preserved here with their QA finding, never deleted
art_asset_directory_convention.frame_masters: PROPOSED: tools/card_art/assets/frames/<rarity>.png (or repo-consistent equivalent) - see frame_master_inventory_v1.json in this same directory for the current (missing) state
art_asset_directory_convention.composed_card_assets: PROPOSED: tools/card_art/output/production_composed_v2/<canonical_id>/ - built by a future, separate frame-composition pipeline, never by the image-generation runner
art_asset_directory_convention.app_derivatives: Owned by the mobile app build pipeline, out of card_art's scope entirely
art_asset_directory_convention.no_silent_replacement_rule: A file at any of the above paths is never silently overwritten - a corrected/regenerated image gets a new provenance record (new prompt_sha256, new generation_batch) alongside the old one, exactly mirroring the repair_history pattern already used for the V1 Batch-1 repair.
